title: Quadratic bent functions with derivative-kernel spreads
summary: Characterize the quadratic bent functions whose derivative kernels over all nonzero directions form a spread.

formal_statement.body: Let $F:\mathbb F_2^{2m}\to\mathbb F_2^m$ be a quadratic bent function in the source setting. Characterize exactly those $F$ for which the family $$\{\ker(D_aF):a\in\mathbb F_2^{2m}\setminus\{0\}\},\qquad D_aF(x)=F(x+a)+F(x),$$ forms a spread of $\mathbb F_2^{2m}$. Give proved necessary and sufficient conditions valid for every such $F$.

scope.domain: Quadratic bent functions and the kernels of all their nonzero derivatives
assumptions: $F$ is quadratic and bent in the source vectorial setting
The collection ranges over every nonzero direction $a$
scope.unresolved_remainder: Provide a necessary-and-sufficient characterization that decides the spread property for every quadratic bent function in the source domain.

progress.summary: The source asks for a general characterization of quadratic bent functions whose nonzero derivative kernels form a spread.
